

# Top-Down Battle Royale

## How to Play

- Drop onto the map and scavenge for weapons, armor, and consumables.  
- Keep an eye on the shrinking safe zone; the storm deals escalating damage.  
- Move with WASD or arrow keys, aim and shoot with the mouse.  
- Sprint with Shift, use items with keys 1‑8, and revive downed teammates.  
- Eliminate opponents; the last survivor or team claims victory.
